title.text: A support team for leaders with big goals, broad opportunities, and a focus on the future

title.text1: Why us? Why do so many people choose our service?

text.first: Our websites are fully responsive, meaning they work seamlessly on computers, tablets, and mobile devices.
text.second: We create effective websites that attract users, increase revenue, and help businesses grow.
text.third: We complete projects on time and with high quality. We quickly respond to unexpected challenges and find solutions.
text.fourth: We provide high-quality services at affordable and competitive prices. We have options suitable for every budget.
text.fiveth: Our websites are protected with modern antivirus software and firewalls, making them resistant to spam bots and cyber attacks.
text.sixth: We provide high-quality services at affordable and competitive prices. We have options suitable for every budget.
text.seventh: The website comes with a user-friendly and simple management system, allowing you to manage it independently.
text.eight: With us, you won't face domain and hosting issues. We offer a free .uz domain for one year and hosting for three months (then $10/month).
text.nineth: Your website will be continuously monitored online 24/7 to ensure uninterrupted operation.

title.first: How long does it take to create a website?
title.second: Why are the prices so low?
title.third: I don’t know how to manage a website. Is that a problem?
title.fourth: Can I fully manage the website myself?
title.fiveth: Do you ensure that the site works well on mobile phones?
title.sixth: Who provides hosting and domain for the website?
title.seventh: What should I do if I need to update or modify my website?
title.eight: What types of websites do you create?
title.eleventh: Do you optimize my website for search engines (SEO)?
title.twelveth: Can the website support multiple languages?
title.thirteenth: Can I get a consultation before creating my website?
title.fourteenth: Do you provide technical support after purchasing the website?

text.first: It depends on your requirements. A simple website is usually completed within 5-10 business days. Larger or more complex projects may take longer. After discussing your project, we can give you an exact timeline.
text.second: Our prices are low compared to the quality because we have optimized our process and reduced unnecessary costs to provide high quality at an affordable price.
text.third: Not at all! We provide training on website management for all our clients and offer ongoing support if needed.
text.fourth: Yes, we provide you with an easy-to-use content management system (CMS) that allows you to manage your website effortlessly. Additionally, we offer support services.
text.fiveth: Yes, all our websites are designed to be fully responsive, ensuring they work perfectly on mobile phones, tablets, and other devices.
text.sixth: We assist you in registering hosting and domains or offer our own hosting services. We can also help connect an existing domain to your website.
text.seventh: You can make changes yourself using the user-friendly content management system. If professional help is needed, our technical team is available.
text.eight: We create various types of websites, including: Business card websites, Online stores, Blogs, Corporate websites, Portfolios, and other customized websites.
text.nineth: Payments can be made in stages. A 50% upfront payment is required before starting the project, and the remaining balance is paid upon completion.
text.tenth: Yes, we install SSL certificates and follow best security practices to ensure website safety.
text.eleventh: Yes, we implement basic SEO for search engine optimization and also offer additional SEO services.
text.twelveth: Absolutely, we offer multilingual support for websites, allowing you to manage content in multiple languages easily.
text.thirteenth: Of course! We answer all your questions and help you find the best solution for your project. Consultations are free!
text.fourteenth: Yes, we offer technical support after website creation. This service is free for up to one year and can be extended under contract.
text.fifteenth: The design is customized according to your brand and preferences. We provide several options, and the website is developed based on your selection.
